response.sql: WITH per_rating AS (SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS avg_length, AVG(rental_rate / replacement_cost) AS avg_ratio FROM film WHERE replacement_cost >= 20.99 GROUP BY rating) SELECT AVG(avg_length) AS avg_of_avg_length, AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_of_avg_ratio FROM per_rating

assumptions.assumption: The ratio is computed per film as rental_rate / replacement_cost and then averaged within each rating; AVG ignores NULL lengths automatically. The final row is an unweighted average of the per-rating averages, so each rating counts equally regardless of film count.

Ratings with no films meeting the cost threshold are absent from the per-rating step and so are not counted in the final average. The verified data shows five populated ratings, so this probably does not matter.
